tools.name: annotate_native_function
tools.title: Annotate Native Function
tools.description: Atomically rename one function and/or change entry comments, verify readback, and return its refreshed complete dossier. Ghidra resolves interior addresses to function entries; use procedure_address to select the entry explicitly. Edits change analysis metadata, never executable bytes; empty comment text clears it. Invalid edits roll back together. Ghidra checkpoint mode saves on normal close; ephemeral mode discards edits, including in CLI cleanup. Check binary_session for the mode. Windows P0 and providers without this capability are unsupported.

tools.name: inspect_native_load_image
tools.title: Inspect Native Load Image
tools.description: Inspect provider source digests, loaded mappings, relocations, entries and register context without executing or changing the target. Independent snapshot checks support DOS MZ, selected COM, raw binaries and GameCube DOL; other formats retain observations with unsupported verification. Relocation symbols do not prove runtime binding. detail summary retains complete Evidence for inspect_analysis_view kind native-load-image, collection source_files/mappings/relocations/entry_points/entry_context/checks/sections. Null collections are unrecorded/inapplicable; payload bytes require explicit fields. Overlay and uninitialized coverage remain explicit.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: inspect_native_data_type
tools.title: Inspect Native Data Type
tools.description: Inspect one recovered type by exact database category path or defined typed data address. Returns observed size, alignment, packing, fields, bitfields, enum values, and child type identities; source-level authority and flexible-tail semantics remain unknown unless substantiated.

tools.name: inspect_native_instruction
tools.title: Inspect Native Instruction
tools.description: Inspect bytes, mnemonic, operand tokens, flow and typed incoming/outgoing references at one code/data address. Ghidra preserves the query and separately reports a containing listed instruction/data object; unlisted memory is not decoded. References do not establish runtime access, and token-only operands do not establish memory decomposition. Use inspect_native_data_type at a data object's start for layout, without inferring a selected field. Retained references use inspect_analysis_view kind native-instruction-references; null coverage is unavailable or unrecorded.

tools.name: resolve_native_call_targets
tools.title: Resolve Native Call Targets
tools.description: Resolve one explicit static call site using typed provider call references. Preserves ambiguous targets as candidates and unresolved computed calls as unknown; does not execute code or traverse a call graph.

tools.name: address_name
tools.title: Address Name
tools.description: Resolve the primary analyzed name at a code or data address. Headless providers require an explicit address; GUI providers may default to their current cursor. Null means the provider has no primary name at that address.

tools.name: comment
tools.title: Comment
tools.description: Read the regular analysis comment at an explicit address, or the current cursor where supported. Returns null when absent; use set_comment to write one.

tools.name: current_address
tools.title: Current Address
tools.description: Return Hopper's current cursor address for the selected document. Use only for interactive navigation state; prefer explicit addresses in reproducible investigations.

tools.name: current_procedure
tools.title: Current Procedure
tools.description: Return the analyzed procedure containing Hopper's current cursor. This uses GUI cursor state and is not a procedure-name lookup.

tools.name: current_document
tools.title: Current Document
tools.description: Return the document currently selected by REA's Hopper bridge.

tools.name: goto_address
tools.title: Goto Address
tools.description: Move Hopper's GUI cursor to a mapped address and return the observed cursor address. Interior coordinates snap to the containing analyzed object's start. Unmapped destinations fail without moving the cursor. This changes navigation state but not analysis data; use explicit-address tools for headless workflows.

tools.name: inline_comment
tools.title: Inline Comment
tools.description: Read the inline instruction comment at an explicit address, or the current cursor where supported. Returns null when absent; use set_inline_comment to write one.

tools.name: list_bookmarks
tools.title: List Bookmarks
tools.description: List every bookmark in the selected Hopper document as address and name pairs; unnamed bookmarks retain a null name. Use bookmarks as analyst-authored navigation aids; this does not discover code references.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.title: List Documents
tools.description: List provider program or document identities. Hopper may expose several documents; a Ghidra headless session contains exactly its one imported Program.

tools.name: list_names
tools.title: List Names
tools.description: List every analyzed memory and external symbol as address/value pairs. Provider metadata distinguishes Ghidra primary, dynamic, external, type, and source facts when available. Select detail summary for counts and retained native-inventory pages; complete remains the default.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: list_procedures
tools.title: List Procedures
tools.description: List every analyzed procedure as address/value pairs after provider analysis. Ghidra metadata distinguishes thunks and external functions; use returned addresses in later function operations. Select detail summary for counts and retained native-inventory pages; complete remains the default.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: list_segments
tools.title: List Segments
tools.description: List segments or memory blocks using exclusive end addresses. Ghidra reports block permissions, address space, image base, initialization, and overlay facts; Hopper marks unavailable permissions explicitly.

tools.name: list_strings
tools.title: List Strings
tools.description: List every provider-reported string object or candidate, or filter to one address, as address/value pairs with encoding, terminator status, and byte length when available. Hopper reads complete typed objects and retains its original display text as provider_value; long literals may span adjacent unterminated objects. Kuna scans mapped printable sequences of at least five characters, including unterminated fragments; references are not computed. Select detail summary for counts and retained native-inventory pages; complete remains the default.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: next_address
tools.title: Next Address
tools.description: Return the next analyzed object address after an explicit address or current cursor. This is a navigation primitive, not instruction-flow or CFG analysis.

tools.name: prev_address
tools.title: Prev Address
tools.description: Return the previous analyzed object start before an explicit address or current cursor. This is a navigation primitive and may fail at document boundaries; data objects and instructions remain distinct from control flow.

tools.name: procedure_address
tools.title: Procedure Address
tools.description: Resolve an unambiguous procedure symbol name or provider-normalized address to its canonical entry address. External address spaces remain explicit. Select detail summary for selected facts and a context digest; native-observation and native-context views retain complete source access.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: procedure_assembly
tools.title: Procedure Assembly
tools.description: Return assembly for one analyzed procedure identified by symbol or hexadecimal address. Use when pseudocode loses calling-convention or instruction-level detail; output is currently returned as one unpaginated string. Ghidra terminal-call assumptions that may cut the analyzed body are reported in Evidence limitations.

tools.name: procedure_callees
tools.title: Procedure Callees
tools.description: Return the provider's resolved direct callees for one procedure identified by symbol or address. Unresolved indirect calls may be absent; use analyze_function and typed references to preserve available edge uncertainty. Ghidra terminal-call assumptions that may cut the analyzed body are reported in Evidence limitations. Select detail summary for selected facts and a context digest; native-observation and native-context views retain complete source access.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: procedure_callers
tools.title: Procedure Callers
tools.description: Return the provider's resolved direct callers for one procedure identified by symbol or address. Results reflect completed static analysis and may omit unresolved indirect references. Ghidra terminal-call assumptions that may cut the analyzed body are reported in Evidence limitations. Select detail summary for selected facts and a context digest; native-observation and native-context views retain complete source access.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: procedure_info
tools.title: Procedure Info
tools.description: Return provider metadata for one procedure identified by symbol or address: entrypoint, signature, locals, size, block count, and complete inclusive body ranges when observed. Extents reflect the provider's analyzed body; Ghidra terminal-call assumptions that may cut it are reported in Evidence limitations. Hopper locals preserve observed names and signed stack displacements; source types remain unknown. Body byte count and enclosing span remain distinct; unavailable extent is explicit.

tools.name: read_function_instructions
tools.title: Read Function Instructions
tools.description: Return every raw instruction for one analyzed procedure. Instruction text and body extent are provider-specific. Ghidra terminal-call assumptions that may cut the analyzed body are reported in limitations.

tools.name: search_bytes
tools.title: Search Bytes
tools.description: Find masked byte signatures in initialized analyzed memory. Hex byte pairs and ?? wildcards are supported; an optional equal-length hex mask selects bits. Bounds are inclusive. Without bounds, unloaded blocks and loaded overlays are skipped and listed separately; select an overlay address space with start or end to search it. Matches are ordered by provider address and may span adjacent eligible initialized blocks; gaps and excluded blocks end a contiguous range. A match’s segment and file offset describe its starting address. Coverage describes this page; reuse the same query with next_cursor to continue. Uninitialized blocks are listed separately. Ghidra only; Hopper is unavailable.

tools.name: read_bytes
tools.title: Read Bytes
tools.description: Read analyzed bytes from one provider-normalized virtual address. Ghidra reads initialized memory, which can include loader fixups; these bytes can differ from the original file. The hexadecimal payload reports the exact returned length; incomplete reads remain explicit and unsupported provider APIs return typed capability unavailability.

tools.name: address_to_file_offset
tools.title: Address To File Offset
tools.description: Map one provider-normalized virtual address to its original nonnegative file offset. The mapping is for that address; it does not imply a contiguous file range or that analyzed memory bytes equal file bytes. Hopper verifies the original bytes against the selected executable digest and translates FAT image-relative offsets using the loaded header. Results preserve the provider coordinate, image base, and source path. Unmapped addresses fail explicitly; changed or unavailable sources return typed errors retaining native mapping facts as partial evidence.

tools.name: procedure_references
tools.title: Procedure References
tools.description: Return incoming or outgoing reference edges for one procedure. Ghidra preserves detailed reference flags; Hopper preserves native CallReference classifications and exact endpoints. Select detail summary to retain complete Evidence and page references or unresolved calls using inspect_analysis_view kind native-procedure-references. Page coverage describes retained observations, not complete discovery or proof the target ran.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: procedure_pseudo_code
tools.title: Procedure Pseudo Code
tools.description: Decompile one analyzed procedure by symbol or provider-normalized address. Returns provider-specific pseudocode or null, never original source; raw_result.pseudocode_absence distinguishes reported provider-failure from not-in-export, otherwise the cause is unknown. Use procedure_assembly for instruction precision. detail summary retains text for inspect_analysis_view native/pseudocode pages without another decompile; complete is default. analysis: independent_fresh requests a separate attempt only when binary_session advertises independent_decompile; it may use different analysis context. analysis: call_destination attempts standalone decompilation at an exact incoming direct call to an arm64 Mach-O address outside the procedure inventory when the capability declares call_destination_decompile. The result retains the call site and does not establish a discovered procedure. Ghidra accepts file-offset:0x... or unique file offsets when a 0x selector resolves to no procedure; existing analysis addresses take precedence, and space-qualified addresses avoid that fallback. Its terminal-call assumptions may truncate the analyzed body, as limitations report.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: resolve_containing_procedure
tools.title: Resolve Containing Procedure
tools.description: Resolve an arbitrary address, including an interior instruction or exact external entry, to its provider-analyzed containing procedure. A negative result distinguishes outside segments from not in a procedure and is never guessed from nearby symbols. Select detail summary for selected facts and a context digest; native-observation and native-context views retain complete source access.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: search_procedures
tools.title: Search Procedures
tools.description: Find analyzed procedures by literal name (default) or regex, including accepted secondary names. Returns deterministic provider-inventory matches under primary names with matched_aliases and available thunk/external metadata. For Ghidra case-insensitive literal searches, raw_result retains unfiltered candidates; normalized_result holds matches. detail summary retains native-inventory pages. Regex uses Java Pattern in Ghidra and ECMAScript Unicode in Kuna, IDA and Hopper; binary_session and errors report effective limits and recovery.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: search_strings
tools.title: Search Strings
tools.description: Find provider-reported strings by literal text (default) or regex. Complete results cover that inventory, not all artifact text; packed/undefined strings or independently matched fragments may be missing. Ghidra search_bytes finds known encoded bytes without establishing string identity/use; xrefs inspects references at a known address. Kuna scans mapped sequences of at least five characters without references or read_bytes. Hopper preserves decoded typed objects, display text and decoding unknowns. For Ghidra case-insensitive literal searches, raw_result holds candidates; normalized_result holds matches. detail summary retains native-inventory pages. Regex uses Java Pattern in Ghidra and ECMAScript Unicode elsewhere; binary_session/errors report limits.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: set_address_name
tools.title: Set Address Name
tools.description: Assign an analyst name to one mapped hexadecimal address and report whether the native edit succeeded and exact readback matched. Hopper rejects symbol names exceeding 1024 UTF-16 code units before mutation, and rejects names owned by another address; use set_addresses_names to explicitly move or swap labels among selected addresses. This mutates analysis metadata.

tools.name: set_addresses_names
tools.title: Set Addresses Names
tools.description: Assign analyst names to multiple mapped addresses in one call and return per-address edit/readback success booleans. Hopper validates mapped destinations, native string representations, its 1024 UTF-16 code-unit symbol-name limit, and unique destinations/names before applying edits; its labels may move or swap only among explicitly selected addresses, and unselected label owners remain unchanged. Ghidra rejects any address whose name another selected address also requests or holds in that namespace; others still apply, with reasons in raw_result.failures. This mutates analysis metadata; verify failures individually.

tools.name: set_bookmark
tools.title: Set Bookmark
tools.description: Create or update a bookmark at a mapped hexadecimal address and report readback success. Omit name to preserve an existing name or create an unnamed bookmark; an empty string clears the bookmark name. This mutates navigation metadata; bookmarks are analyst-authored navigation aids, not binary evidence.

tools.name: set_comment
tools.title: Set Comment
tools.description: Write a regular analysis comment at a hexadecimal address and return whether readback matched. An empty comment clears it. This mutates the Hopper document; use comments to record evidence IDs or reasoning.

tools.name: set_inline_comment
tools.title: Set Inline Comment
tools.description: Write an inline instruction comment at a hexadecimal address and return whether readback matched. An empty comment clears it; Hopper may flatten newlines, producing false on exact readback. This mutates analysis metadata.

tools.name: unset_bookmark
tools.title: Unset Bookmark
tools.description: Remove the bookmark at a mapped hexadecimal address and return whether it is absent. Hopper also permits removing an existing legacy bookmark outside mapped memory. This mutates navigation metadata and does not alter binary bytes.

tools.name: xrefs
tools.title: Xrefs
tools.description: Return analyzed references to a code or data address. Hopper may default to its current cursor; headless providers such as Ghidra require an explicit address. Kuna also accepts names in its own inventory, including data names; an unlisted name may still exist in the target. Use to connect strings, globals, selectors, and functions; bare addresses are untyped and indirect references may be incomplete. Page a retained result with inspect_analysis_view and native-observation; use native-context for source caveats. Use inspect_native_instruction at the target address for typed incoming references where supported.

tools.name: inspect_native_dispatch_metadata
tools.title: Inspect Native Dispatch Metadata
tools.description: Inspect analyzed Objective-C class/method and Swift mangled symbols, with optional exact Objective-C import-pointer binding facts from the selected Mach-O slice. Returns decoded names up to max_records, provider/profile identity, target digest when available, facet coverage and per-record Evidence. Symbol observations do not establish runtime layouts, conformances or witness/class tables. The selected provider owns name discovery. max_input_bytes bounds the whole-file Mach-O read; unresolved bindings remain partial or unsupported.

tools.name: get_objc_classes
tools.title: Get Objc Classes
tools.description: Find Objective-C class labels, optionally by literal substring. Labels remain separate unless exact selected-image pointer-fixup Evidence establishes the same imported class binding, including library, ordinal, weak status and addend. Missing binding proof remains unknown, partial or unsupported.

tools.name: get_objc_protocols
tools.title: Get Objc Protocols
tools.description: Discover and deduplicate Objective-C and Swift protocol labels.

tools.name: batch_decompile
tools.title: Batch Decompile
tools.description: Decompile an explicit list of procedure symbols/addresses in input order, with one provider read active per batch. Returns per-item pseudocode, unavailable or error outcomes and aggregate counts; input selectors and observed canonical procedure identities remain separate. Null pseudocode is unavailable, without an inferred capability or retry reason; failed counts include unavailable items. detail summary retains the batch for inspect_analysis_view item/body pages; complete includes every body. Per-function limits do not bound the whole batch.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: decompile_all
tools.title: Decompile All
tools.description: Export pseudocode for all or selected analyzed functions to a directory; returns a manifest/index, with bodies kept in files. Existing output requires resume with matching target, provider, profile and layout; verified files are skipped and conflicts preserved. External functions produce no file. Item failures do not stop others; cancellation keeps written files. retry_failed: independent_fresh retries only provider-reported function failures when supported, retaining each attempt and its limitations; independent attempts may use different analysis context. layout dwarf falls back to address filenames when compilation-unit paths are unavailable. Select limit/resume to fit the whole client deadline; per-function limits do not bound the export.

tools.name: get_call_graph
tools.title: Get Call Graph
tools.description: Traverse the provider-observed caller or callee graph from one symbol/address, returning canonical-address nodes with per-node outcomes. Use trace_call_path for a shortest path to a goal, or build_call_path to compose existing function dossiers without provider reads. Indirect calls may be unresolved; this is not a whole-program CFG. detail summary retains the complete graph for native-observation pages and native-context caveats.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: analyze_swift_types
tools.title: Analyze Swift Types
tools.description: Classify analyzed Swift procedure names into classes, structs, enums, protocols and extensions using manglings or same-address symbol aliases. Returns deduplicated procedure-name counts, not unique source types; provider names, mangled_names and unresolved classifications remain available. Category and case-sensitive literal pattern filters do not suppress unclassified rows. Example: {category: "structs", pattern: "Pair"}.

tools.name: find_xrefs_to_name
tools.title: Find Xrefs To Name
tools.description: Find references to an exact analyzed symbol name: resolves the name, then returns its address and referencing addresses. name_not_found means lookup is unresolved, not that a reference search found none or the target lacks the symbol. References are address-only; use inspect_native_instruction for typed incoming references where supported. Kuna lacks the required general name inventory; xrefs can resolve names its inventory knows.

tools.name: binary_overview
tools.title: Binary Overview
tools.description: Summarize the bound document, complete provider-inventory procedure/string row counts, and segments when supported. Counts do not establish discovery of every function/string and are not comparable across providers. Omitted segments mean unavailable coverage. image_base is returned only when observed segments agree. Use search_procedures, list_procedures or analyze_function directly when the procedure is already known.

tools.name: analyze_function
tools.title: Analyze Function
tools.description: Inspect one native function by symbol or provider-returned address. Default summary returns identity, pseudocode size, facet counts and value-flow availability while retaining the complete dossier. Read selected facts with inspect_analysis_view using normalized_result.parent_evidence_id; detail complete returns everything inline. Facets include pseudocode, assembly, body ranges, comments, calls, references, strings/names, CFG and native API observations. Extents reflect provider analysis; limitations report unknown ranges and possible Ghidra terminal-call truncation.

detail.description: summary (default) returns a compact dossier and retains the complete analyze_function Evidence in this session; page pseudocode, references and value-flow through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id with inspect_analysis_view. complete returns the full dossier inline.

tools.name: inspect_native_api
tools.title: Inspect Native Api
tools.description: Inspect recovered parameter/return boundary types and jump-table dispatch for one native function selected by symbol or address. Returns confidence, supporting Evidence, case/data/target mappings, unsupported facets and residual unknowns. Null case values are unresolved, never known defaults. Use analyze_function for the broader function dossier.

tools.name: trace_feature
tools.title: Trace Feature
tools.description: Search procedure/string inventories for the complete literal query, then query xrefs at matched start addresses. Interior-byte references are not searched; empty results or truncated: false never establish no references. Containment refusals preserve an unavailable owner, and reference kinds remain unknown. For typed incoming procedure references use procedure_references, comparing target addresses for exact-entry matches. detail summary retains matches/references/unknowns for inspect_analysis_view kind native-feature-trace.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: trace_call_path
tools.title: Trace Call Path
tools.description: Resolve start and optional goal symbols or addresses, then trace direct callers or callees. Returns observed edges and a shortest path within the provider-observed graph. search_scope distinguishes the observed-graph result from whether discovery is established; a missing goal is unknown when relationship reads or discovery are incomplete. Unresolved indirect calls remain unknown.

tools.name: trace_native_ui_action
tools.title: Trace Native Ui Action
tools.description: Trace one unique compiled UI action, object ID, native symbol or exact function address through authored connections, encoded or symbolized Objective-C handlers, and bounded static call references. Typed direct and resolved indirect calls, ambiguous candidates, inferred untyped provider callees, and targetless sites remain distinct. Runtime reachability is unknown; use trace_native_values for recovered value dependencies.

tools.name: trace_native_values
tools.title: Trace Native Values
tools.description: Trace static value dependencies across resolved calls from one native procedure: high-p-code def-use, constants, operators, memory/branch operations and derived argument/return bindings. Alias effects, missing bindings, persistent state and RNG roles remain unknown. Caller-selected budgets bound traversal and retained facts; nodes are paged. A Ghidra per-function timeout does not bound the traversal: allow startup and every attempted function, or reduce max_functions.

tools.name: observe_native_ui
tools.title: Observe Native Ui
tools.description: Observe one already-running native app window by PID/window ID, bound to the active Mach-O target. Returns a bounded accessibility tree and window screenshot; screenshot or accessibility must be enabled. Permission denial does not broaden capture or launch the target. native_ui_deadline_ms sets this call's deadline independently of output and wait-step limits. Use capture_native_ui_scenario to interact.

tools.name: capture_native_ui_scenario
tools.title: Capture Native Ui Scenario
tools.description: Interact with one exact native app window through selected-element press, scroll, AXValue text entry and bounded waits. Returns ordered before/after captures and per-step failures; screenshot or accessibility must be enabled. Actions may change app data, network activity and persistent state; REA leaves that state in place. native_ui_deadline_ms controls the scenario deadline, independently of output allowance and wait-step caps. Use observe_native_ui for observation only.

tools.name: observe_native_calls
tools.title: Observe Native Calls
tools.description: Launch the active Mach-O under LLDB and record selected function/Objective-C method entries; the owned process is killed at max_events or duration_ms. Target execution uses the caller's permissions and may write files, show UI or use network. Hits auto-continue; REA evaluates no expressions and attaches to no other process. Returns addresses, thread/module/symbol, raw argument registers, selector/receiver facts, optional frames, stdout/stderr and limitations. Hardened-runtime targets need get-task-allow. Set capture_limits before launch; later changes cannot recover omitted observations.

tools.name: inspect_macho
tools.title: Inspect Macho
tools.description: Inspect Mach-O slices, load commands, linkage, build metadata, segments/sections and permissions without launching Hopper. Returns command provenance and explicit coverage; segment and section file offsets are slice-relative, so add selected_architecture.container_file_offset for an input-file offset. detail summary retains complete Evidence for inspect_analysis_view kind macho rather than delivering large symbol lists inline. native_command_timeout_ms bounds each Xcode command, independently of output admission.

detail.description: Omitted or complete returns the complete inspection Evidence. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; use normalized_result.parent_evidence_id for macho pages.

tools.name: inspect_signature
tools.title: Inspect Signature
tools.description: Inspect the selected Mach-O slice's signing identity, hashes, authorities, requirement, entitlements and hardened-runtime state from a digest-verified snapshot. Other slices are checked for unsigned state with separate metadata coverage. Returns command provenance; native_command_timeout_ms bounds each codesign command independently of output admission.

tools.name: inspect_plist
tools.title: Inspect Plist
tools.description: Parse Info.plist from an open binary or bundle-resource session, or select path within that session. Use open_binary or open_bundle_resources first. Returns normalized JSON from a private temporary copy of the selected plist. native_command_timeout_ms bounds each file/plutil command independently of input, decode and nesting limits. XML requires plutil validation and may be refused at a shallower depth.

tools.name: list_architectures
tools.title: List Architectures
tools.description: List thin/universal Mach-O slices with file offsets, sizes, alignment, coverage and native-tool provenance. native_command_timeout_ms bounds lipo, independently of output admission.

tools.name: demangle_swift
tools.title: Demangle Swift
tools.description: Demangle an ordered list of single-line Swift symbols without Hopper. Returns demangled, unchanged or invalid for every input; invalid entries do not discard valid companions. native_command_timeout_ms bounds swift-demangle, independently of output admission.

tools.name: inspect_with_objdump
tools.title: Inspect With Objdump
tools.description:
Inspect a local artifact with caller-selected objdump and GNU-style arguments; the executable implementation/version is unverified. operation disassemble optionally scopes to symbol; omission selects all code sections. operation architectures needs no path and captures -i output without establishing artifact support. Returns authoritative stdout/stderr and artifact SHA-256, with lossy UTF-8 and truncation explicit; there is no stable normalized disassembly format. DWARF debug links are off unless follow_debug_links true; external file identities remain unbound. DEBUGINFOD_URLS is cleared to prevent debuginfod requests. Default complete returns Evidence; summary retains it and returns one command observation for later inspect_analysis_view/export via parent_evidence_id. command_timeout_ms bounds each phase; max_output_bytes independently bounds combined output (16 MiB default). Both apply next call without restart; truncation termination leaves completion unknown, and raising output does not raise client receive limits.

Provide a complete input group: path + operation + [follow_debug_links] + [command_timeout_ms] + [max_output_bytes] + [detail]; path + operation + [follow_debug_links] + [command_timeout_ms] + [max_output_bytes] + [symbol] + [detail]; operation + [command_timeout_ms] + [max_output_bytes] + [detail].

detail.description: complete returns the original Evidence; summary retains that complete parent and returns command output once with completion and source context.

tools.name: execute_rizin_command
tools.title: Execute Rizin Command
tools.description: Run one caller-selected Rizin command on a local artifact. Commands/plugins can execute code, mutate files, access network and read outside the artifact; those external inputs are not Evidence-bound. Suppresses user settings/scripts but retains plugins. Raw stdout/stderr is authoritative, JSON is command-specific, and UTF-8 loss/truncation is explicit; output-limit termination leaves completion unknown. Rizin exits 0 even when its shell refuses a statement; completion_status rejected marks that refusal, and later statements did not run. Other command failures can still exit 0, so inspect stderr before treating empty output as absence. For raw images, asm_arch/asm_bits/asm_cpu select decoding and base_address maps offset 0; base_address also passes -n to skip loaders even on ELF, without REA confirming either. An admitted command retires shared binary analysis: close Ghidra explicitly first, then open_binary after effects settle. command_timeout_ms is per-phase and max_output_bytes bounds combined output (16 MiB default); both apply next call without restart and do not raise client receive limits or persistent debugger deadlines.

tools.name: list_cutter_sessions
tools.title: List Cutter Sessions
tools.description: Find live REA bridge sessions in Cutter and return document identity and bridge-directory security status. Examines at most 256 descriptors with up to eight concurrent probes; excess capacity returns bridge_directory_capacity_exceeded, not an empty session list. The fixed discovery budget is separate from REA_BRIDGE_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES and cannot be raised at runtime.

tools.name: cutter_command
tools.title: Cutter Command
tools.description: Run one arbitrary Rizin command in a selected Cutter session; it may persist edits or execute plugin effects. Reports completion uncertainty as Evidence; do not retry automatically. An admitted command retires shared binary analysis: close active Ghidra explicitly first, then reopen with open_binary after command effects settle. Supply session_id and expected_generation from discovery. REA_BRIDGE_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES bounds authenticated request/response payloads excluding LF (default 16777216, range 7464..536870887); mismatched client/Cutter budgets refuse dispatch. An out-of-band Cutter without this setting uses the default.

tools.name: start_gdb_session
tools.title: Start Gdb Session
tools.description: Start a persistent caller-supplied GDB session and return its session ID. Linux only; detaching a live inferior during close requires a verified durable output TTY. Startup suppresses init files and auto-loading, preferring MI3. Optional executable hashes and loads an initial file without running it; command Evidence names this initial selection, and later console loads do not rebind it. Omission leaves the session target unknown. Optional inferior_tty selects a verified terminal for later inferior runs; keep it available after GDB exits so close can detach a live inferior safely. The session belongs to this REA server process.

tools.name: gdb_console
tools.title: Gdb Console
tools.description: Run one unrestricted command in a persistent GDB session; commands can run shell, change target state, access files and network. Returns ordered MI/console/target/log Evidence. A timeout retains collected records with completion_status unknown and stops the owned debugger; closing does not imply target termination. Default complete preserves full Evidence; summary retains it and omits duplicate stream/raw mirrors for inspect_analysis_view summary queries. In a shared server this command retires active binary analysis: close Ghidra explicitly first, then reopen the binary after command effects settle.

detail.description: complete returns the original Evidence; summary retains that complete parent and returns command output once with completion and source context.

tools.name: gdb_session_status
tools.title: Gdb Session Status
tools.description: Return the observed lifecycle state and bounded recent MI records and process diagnostics for one persistent REA GDB session; closed_reason says why a closed session stopped, and truncation and invalid-UTF-8 fields report discarded or lossy data.

tools.name: close_gdb_session
tools.title: Close Gdb Session
tools.description: Close the owned GDB process after verifying the inferior state. When one live thread group has a verified durable output TTY, REA automatically detaches it, which may resume target execution; otherwise close reports that a disposition is required. REA never kills attached or remote targets as part of debugger cleanup. In a shared MCP server, this admitted close retires any active binary-analysis session; after target effects have settled, call open_binary before further analysis. Close an active Ghidra session explicitly first.

tools.name: start_rizin_debug_session
tools.title: Start Rizin Debug Session
tools.description: Start a persistent Rizin debugger for one selected target/backend. Linux and a caller-selected TTY for inferior stdin/stdout/stderr are required; the target may use that terminal after detach. Startup suppresses user settings/scripts while retaining plugins. Detach requires verified output sinks, no target access to the debugger command stream, and dbg.exitkills=false. Capabilities depend on the installed backend. This shared-server operation retires binary analysis: close Ghidra explicitly first, then reopen the binary after effects settle.

tools.name: rizin_debug_command
tools.title: Rizin Debug Command
tools.description: Run one unrestricted command in a persistent Rizin debugger; it can access target state, plugins, shell, files and network. Returns raw/interleaved session output as Evidence. Output/frame limits stop the owned debugger and retain partial output with output_truncated and unknown completion. Prequeued unsolicited frames refuse the call because correlation is ambiguous. This shared-server operation retires binary analysis: close Ghidra explicitly first, then reopen the binary after effects settle.

tools.name: rizin_debug_session_status
tools.title: Rizin Debug Session Status
tools.description: Return observed lifecycle state and bounded recent NUL-framed output and process diagnostics for one Rizin debugger session; closed_reason says why a closed session stopped, truncation fields report discarded data, and output_invalid_utf8 reports whether invalid UTF-8 has been observed in session frame bytes; recent output may contain replacement characters.

tools.name: close_rizin_debug_session
tools.title: Close Rizin Debug Session
tools.description: Close the REA-owned Rizin debugger only after verifying no inferior remains or detaching one with a verified caller-selected TTY output sink. A detached target may continue running, read from and write to that TTY; target state is otherwise reported as unknown. REA never signals an inferior based on PID or path. In a shared MCP server, this admitted close retires any active binary-analysis session; after target effects have settled, call open_binary before further analysis. Close an active Ghidra session explicitly first.

tools.name: inspect_devicetree
tools.title: Inspect Devicetree
tools.description: Inspect an explicit local flattened devicetree blob (FDT v16/v17) without execution or external tools. Returns validated header, memory reservations, full node/property tree with bounded raw hex, derived standard strings, cells and parent-sized reg tuples, aliases and selected single-cell phandle references with unresolved targets. Binding-specific arrays, overlays and runtime hardware remain unknown. Malformed structure or exhausted named budgets fails without partial success. Complete detail returns all Evidence inline; summary retains it for inspect_analysis_view kind devicetree, collections nodes, properties (requires exact path), reservations and references, with offset/limit pagination.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: inspect_pe_load_config
tools.title: Inspect Pe Load Config
tools.description: Inspect PE32/PE32+ TLS callbacks and sized load configuration without executing the image. Returns callback VA/RVA/file offsets and sections, security cookie, SafeSEH (PE32), CFG flags and table pointers/counts, EH continuation and XFG fields. Flag-derived mitigation claims are labeled inferred. Absent directories are null; malformed structures and exhausted budgets fail without partial success. Reads a stable local regular file without a disassembler.

tools.name: inspect_binary_hardening
tools.title: Inspect Binary Hardening
tools.description: Inspect static hardening declarations in a local ELF, PE or Mach-O, including every universal slice. Reports PIE/ASLR, NX, RELRO, stack-protector/FORTIFY signs, control-flow flags and stripped state with supporting header/import facts. Missing signs may be unknown, especially for static/stripped images. Signature presence does not establish validity; use inspect_signature for Mach-O hardened runtime. No target execution or exploitability claim. Malformed headers/budgets may fail; limited symbol/property-note reads retain header facts and mark affected rows unknown.

tools.name: inspect_native_initializers
tools.title: Inspect Native Initializers
tools.description: List declared initializer/finalizer functions in a local ELF32/64 or selected Mach-O slice without execution. Returns paged slots and resolved target addresses/file offsets, sections, exact symbols and resolution basis from dynamic tags, constructor sections, relocations and fixups. Unestablished slots remain unresolved, never treated as stored zero targets. Missing declarations do not prove no code runs before main.

tools.name: inspect_elf_notes
tools.title: Inspect Elf Notes
tools.description: Inspect one explicit local ELF32/ELF64 image's PT_NOTE program headers and SHT_NOTE sections without executing it or opening a disassembler. Returns note-table file ranges, owners, types, descriptor SHA-256 and hex previews, plus GNU build-id, ABI-tag and gold-version fields, Linux CORE process, mapping, signal, and auxv notes, Android .note.android.ident API-level and NDK version/build fields, and unverified FDO packaging and dlopen declarations when those descriptors match. A missing table is observed absence of those declarations, not proof the image never carried notes in another container. Reads a stable regular file. Malformed ELF structure and exhausted table-walk budgets return no partial success. An invalid or over-budget FDO descriptor retains raw note evidence with a decoding issue. Portable on supported Node hosts; no debug package or catalog is required.

tools.name: inspect_dwarf_units
tools.title: Inspect Dwarf Units
tools.description: Inspect DWARF 2 through 5 compile-unit headers and the unit DIE in one explicit local ELF, Mach-O, or PE image without executing the image or opening a disassembler. Reads .debug_info, .debug_abbrev, .debug_str, .debug_line_str, and .debug_str_offsets, including compressed ELF sections. Returns name, comp_dir, producer, language, and dwo_name with file offsets, paged by offset and limit. A unit that cannot be framed, or a declared .debug_info that was not read, gives partial coverage. Absent .debug_info applies to this file only and does not establish that a separate debug file is absent. Child DIEs, types, line tables, and location expressions are not read. A .dSYM bundle is not opened; pass the DWARF file inside it. Universal Mach-O requires architecture.

tools.name: inspect_elf_debug_link
tools.title: Inspect Elf Debug Link
tools.description: Inspect one explicit local ELF32/ELF64 image for separate debug-file linkage without executing it or opening a disassembler. Returns .gnu_debuglink file name and CRC32, .gnu_debugaltlink file name and build-id, the GNU build-id, conventional lookup path strings, and .gnu_debugdata presence, file offset, and size. An optional candidate_path verifies that one caller-selected file by debuglink CRC32 and build-id equality. The verdict is matches, does_not_match, or cannot_verify. Lookup paths are not opened. The xz MiniDebugInfo payload is not decoded. A missing section is observed absence only when section names are complete, not proof the image never carried that linkage. Reads stable regular files; malformed ELF headers and exhausted note budgets return no partial success. Portable on supported Node hosts.

tools.name: inspect_elf_unwind_ranges
tools.title: Inspect Elf Unwind Ranges
tools.description: Inspect ELF32/64 .eh_frame and .eh_frame_hdr for paged FDE function ranges, associated CIE facts, LSDA/personality pointers, symbol matches and search-table agreement. No execution or disassembler. Missing unwind declarations do not prove no functions; truncated records remain incomplete. .debug_frame is detected but not decoded, CFA instructions are not evaluated, and indirect EH pointers are not dereferenced. Malformed headers or exhausted CIE/FDE budgets fail without partial success.

tools.name: inspect_apple_ips
tools.title: Inspect Apple Ips
tools.description: Inspect a local Apple .ips crash report for process, exception/termination, thread, image and lossless register facts with deterministic classification. Crash parsing supports bug_type string 309; other types, including 288 stackshots, return no crash result. join_path derives static addresses only when image UUID and architecture match a Mach-O slice; it does not symbolicate or read dSYMs. Missing/truncated bodies fail without partial success. No target execution, atos, disassembler or Xcode required.

tools.name: inspect_kernel_module
tools.title: Inspect Kernel Module
tools.description: Inspect an uncompressed local ELF32/64 ET_REL Linux kernel module for ordered .modinfo entries, symbol CRCs, module/export/init/exit section facts and appended signature ranges/digests. No execution, struct module decoding or certificate validation. Missing known sections describe this image only. gzip/xz/zstd require external decompression; extract_artifact does not decode those module containers. Malformed headers or exhausted entry budgets fail without partial success. Portable on supported Node hosts.

tools.name: inspect_elf_dependencies
tools.title: Inspect Elf Dependencies
tools.description: Inspect one explicit local ELF32/ELF64 ET_EXEC or ET_DYN image's load-time dynamic dependencies without executing it, invoking the dynamic loader, or opening a disassembler. Returns ordered DT_NEEDED libraries (duplicates preserved), DT_SONAME, DT_RPATH and DT_RUNPATH as written including $ORIGIN/$LIB/$PLATFORM tokens, decoded DT_FLAGS and DT_FLAGS_1, PT_INTERP, GNU version requirements and definitions, derived per-namespace version maxima, and undefined .dynsym imports joined to library@version when known. A missing PT_DYNAMIC is an observed empty inventory. Relocatable objects use inspect_kernel_module; core dumps use inspect_recorded_crash. Reads a stable regular file; cyclic version chains and exhausted named budgets return no partial success. Unreadable strings or missing tables are reported as partial coverage with issues; complete coverage never retains issues. Omitted/complete detail preserves inline delivery. Select detail summary to retain complete Evidence and return identity, counts and source coverage. Query inspect_analysis_view kind elf-dependencies, collection needed, versions, definitions, maxima or imports, with exact names/original indices, fields and matching-row pagination; collection issues takes original indices and pagination only. Portable on supported Node hosts.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: inspect_kernel_build_config
tools.title: Inspect Kernel Build Config
tools.description: Inspect a local Linux kernel image (vmlinux, raw arm64 Image, x86 bzImage/zImage or configs.ko) for the version/builder/compiler banner and embedded CONFIG_IKCONFIG. Returns config digest/count and paged, optionally exact-name-filtered CONFIG_* values. Only validated marker-framed gzip config is accepted; a literal marker is insufficient. Supported gzip bzImage payloads are searched; other compressed payloads require external decompression. Truncation is incomplete, not absence; budget exhaustion fails without partial success. No target execution or external tools.

tools.name: inspect_byte_entropy
tools.title: Inspect Byte Entropy
tools.description: Inspect Shannon byte entropy for one explicit local file offline, without execution, extraction or external tools. Returns file-wide SHA-256 and entropy, fixed-block entropy for an optional offset/length window, and adjacent high (>=7.2) and low (<=1.0) runs with exact file offsets. Block size is a power of two from 256 to 65536 (default 4096). Complete output can become very large because it includes one row per selected block, and summary detail still retains that full list. Use a shorter length or a larger block_size; the selected window is limited to 32,768 output blocks. Entropy cannot distinguish compression from encryption. Summary detail returns file entropy plus the ten longest runs; retrieve parent Evidence for the full series. The entire file is read even for a window.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: inspect_pe_certificates
tools.title: Inspect Pe Certificates
tools.description: Inspect a local PE32/PE32+ certificate directory without executing it or verifying signatures. Returns WIN_CERTIFICATE ranges/types/digests and structurally decoded PKCS#7 signer, algorithm and X.509 identity fields when present. Missing directory does not establish globally unsigned status. Authenticode digest coverage, trust chains and timestamp validity remain unobserved. Malformed/truncated structures and unsupported PKCS#7 signed-data shapes fail without partial success. No Windows SDK or disassembler required.

tools.name: inspect_pe_imports
tools.title: Inspect Pe Imports
tools.description: Inspect local PE32/PE32+ standard and delay-load imports without execution. Returns DLL/named/ordinal imports, ILT/IAT RVAs, descriptors and a pefile-compatible standard-table import hash only when its row sequence is complete and comparable. Missing declarations do not establish no API use; loaded IAT, bound snapshots and forward resolution remain unknown. Unreadable names/thunks or missing tables yield partial coverage; malformed headers or exhausted budgets fail. No Windows SDK or disassembler required.

tools.name: inspect_windows_shortcut
tools.title: Inspect Windows Shortcut
tools.description: Inspect a local Windows Shell Link (.lnk) without resolving or executing its target, COM, or network access. Returns header/time/display facts, target-ID/link-info paths, arguments, working directory/icon and ExtraData observations, with raw hashes for unknown structures. Tracker and behavioral observations are derived. Malformed structures, odd Unicode lengths or exhausted budgets return typed failures or explicitly partial coverage with the failing offset. No Windows SDK required.

tools.name: inspect_pe_resources
tools.title: Inspect Pe Resources
tools.description: Inspect a local PE32/PE32+ resource tree without execution: type/name/language identities, empty branches, UTF-16 names, payload RVA/file ranges/digests and static group-icon candidates. Language fallback, image decoding and actual UI loading remain unknown. Malformed/ambiguous mappings, non-identical overlaps or exhausted budgets fail without partial success. No Windows SDK or disassembler required.

tools.name: inspect_native_exports
tools.title: Inspect Native Exports
tools.description: Inspect PE/ELF exports without execution or an analysis engine; use inspect_macho for Mach-O. Returns named/ordinal/forwarded PE exports or defined ELF dynamic symbols with binding/type/version, preserving aliases, hidden versions and raw-name qualifications. Unreadable entries are partial; unavailable ELF section metadata can make enumeration unsupported. An empty complete inventory means no declared exports. detail summary retains full Evidence for inspect_analysis_view kind native-exports, collection exports/issues, with exact names/indices, fields and paging; source_index is parent-scoped.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: inspect_binary_layout
tools.title: Inspect Binary Layout
tools.description: Inspect static ELF section/segment, symbol, relocation, linkage and mitigation facts with artifact SHA-256 Evidence, without launching the image. Linux x64 requires caller-supplied pwntools 4.15.0/pyelftools 0.33/Unicorn 2.1.2; supports ELF64 x86-64/little-endian AArch64 and ELF32 i386/little-endian ARM/little- or big-endian MIPS. Unicorn may emulate PLT instructions for derived maps. Runtime addresses/paths and complete relocation/GOT/PLT discovery remain unknown; RELR per-word locations/addends can be unknown. detail summary retains full Evidence for layout section/symbol/mitigation/linkage views. pwntools_timeout_ms bounds each command independently of producer_limits and inherited OS limits. Unsupported, malformed or oversized inputs fail without partial success.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: inspect_recorded_crash
tools.title: Inspect Recorded Crash
tools.description: Inspect a saved Linux ELF64 little-endian amd64/AArch64 core without launching its target or attaching to a live PID. Returns recorded segments, raw notes/ranges, thread registers and SIGINFO as digest-bound Evidence. Historical PIDs do not establish current identity; note coverage and signal/thread joins remain unknown. Optional caller-configured GDB/pwndbg adds core-only mapping candidates from the same snapshot; zero flags mean unknown permissions. Linux x64 requires the documented pwntools profile, with optional pwndbg 2026.09.15. No implicit executable/library pairing, command language or installation. pwntools_timeout_ms and producer_limits control independent per-command budgets; malformed or oversized input fails without partial success.

tools.name: audit_release_exposure
tools.title: Audit Release Exposure
tools.description: Report what static analysis of a shipped application artifact recovers. Accepts one local .app bundle, installation directory, ASAR, or executable. Each check has a stable id, a status, the observation behind it, and fixed remediation text. Unknown and unassessed checks stay in the report. This does not establish that an application is secure. Reads the selected artifact. When the selection is a file, the parent directory is listed for sibling .pdb, .dSYM, .debug, and .map debug companions.

tools.name: inspect_artifact
tools.title: Inspect Artifact
tools.description: Inventory the active archive, app package, firmware container or supported packaged executable without running it. Returns nested content-addressed inventory Evidence with integrity observations, unexplored branches and next probes. Default complete returns the full graph; detail summary retains it for inspect_analysis_view kind inventory using parent_evidence_id, exact paths/IDs, fields and paging. Summary changes delivery, not inventory coverage. Bun/Node SEA/Deno carriers expose stored modules/assets and recorded metadata; opaque bytecode and npm snapshots are not decoded. Local Evidence can include environment-file values and certificate bytes. iNES and NES 2.0 add file-region/reconstruction facts, not mapper execution. Integrity mismatches fail unless record-and-continue explicitly retains untrusted contradictions. Supported macOS DMGs are mounted read-only. Use extract_artifact to materialize regular contents; DMGs instead need a caller-managed read-only mount.

detail.description: Omitted or complete returns the complete inspection Evidence. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; use normalized_result.parent_evidence_id for inventory views.

tools.name: extract_artifact
tools.title: Extract Artifact
tools.description:
Write all or selected regular files from the active supported archive to an absent absolute output_root, or a fresh temporary directory if omitted. Use exact inventory occurrence_ids to select files. Returns IDs and actual output paths; successful files persist. Nested archives are copied, not recursively unpacked. Never overwrites; rejects traversal/symlink escapes and verifies cleanup. Full-input integrity checks still apply: mismatches fail unless record-and-continue retains explicitly untrusted contradictions. DMG extraction is unavailable; use a caller-managed read-only mount on macOS.

`occurrence_ids` entries must be distinct.

tools.name: decode_interface_builder
tools.title: Decode Interface Builder
tools.description: Decode compiled storyboard and nib archives inside the active Apple app bundle, including keyed property lists and NIBArchive object tables, into a bounded object, hierarchy, and connection graph. This is static archive parsing; unrecognized archive classes and unresolved code handlers remain explicit unknowns. A full app graph is often several megabytes; detail summary retains it and returns documents with node, edge and coverage counts, then page rows, optionally one document's, with inspect_analysis_view kind interface-builder.

detail.description: Omitted or complete returns the complete decoded graph Evidence. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; use normalized_result.parent_evidence_id for interface-builder pages.

tools.name: inspect_keyed_archive
tools.title: Inspect Keyed Archive
tools.description: Inspect one Foundation NSKeyedArchiver plist in the active app bundle as original object-table nodes, class descriptors, named roots, and UID edges. Preserves shared and cyclic references without instantiating classes. The path is relative to the bundle; root selection and object pagination preserve original identities.

tools.name: inspect_asset_catalog
tools.title: Inspect Asset Catalog
tools.description: Inspect compiled Assets.car metadata in an active Apple app bundle. Returns stable paginated catalog and rendition records with raw assetutil metadata and catalog digests; rendition bytes are not extracted.

tools.name: trace_dylib_resolution
tools.title: Trace Dylib Resolution
tools.description: Trace how dyld would resolve each Mach-O dylib load for the active Mach-O, or for every executable in the active .app bundle (the main app, XPC services, extensions, login items, helpers). Expands @executable_path, @loader_path, and @rpath through each process's LC_RPATH stack in dependents-first load order, and reports every candidate path with its outcome, the resolved image and digest, weak, re-export, upward, and lazy-load flags, including LC_LAZY_LOAD_DYLIB_INFO linkedit payloads, and derived findings such as unresolved required loads or absent earlier @rpath candidates. Pure header parsing: nothing is executed, and absolute or system paths outside the analyzed root stay undetermined. Select roots or one architecture to narrow large bundles.

tools.name: inspect_desktop_application
tools.title: Inspect Desktop Application
tools.description: Identify runtime candidates and next probes in a local desktop app directory from bounded listings, headers and metadata. Recognizes .NET, Unity Mono/IL2CPP, Unreal, Godot, GameMaker and Electron; returns supporting paths and range hashes. Default summary retains complete Evidence for inspect_analysis_view kind desktop-application; detail complete returns retained facts inline. Identity covers examined ranges, not every file byte. Coverage and unavailable probes remain explicit. No target execution, extraction, network or target changes.

tools.name: inspect_evm_interface
tools.title: Inspect Evm Interface
tools.description: Infer interface candidates from explicit local flat EVM bytecode using bundled EVMole 0.9.3/WASM; select raw or hex encoding. Linux x64 profile; EOF-style EF00 containers are unsupported. Returns selectors, offsets, arguments and mutability candidates, not verified deployment or runtime behavior. Bytecode kind, hardfork and discovery completeness stay unknown. Default complete includes bytecode/full Evidence; detail summary retains it for inspect_analysis_view kind evm, facets functions/bytecode_hex/stdout/stderr, via parent_evidence_id. timeout_ms and producer_limits are independent of each other and worker heap; tighter inherited limits still apply. No target execution, chain/RPC access, signature lookup, wallet action or broadcast.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: inspect_go_binary
tools.title: Inspect Go Binary
tools.description: Read embedded Go compiler, module, dependency/replacement and build-setting metadata from a local ELF, PE or selected Mach-O slice without running it or requiring Go. include_string_literals: true adds inferred static UTF-8 literals; runtime use and dependency completeness remain unknown. Missing build info does not prove the image is not Go. Default complete returns artifact SHA-256, source ranges and original metadata; detail summary retains it for inspect_analysis_view kind go, collections dependencies/settings/string_literals, or kind cyclonedx for one CycloneDX 1.6 document, with parent_evidence_id. Slice ranges remain offsets in the original universal file. No function/type/source recovery. Increase only the reported per-call budget and retry the same artifact; it does not raise parser or MCP delivery limits. Malformed/unsupported inputs fail explicitly.

detail.description: complete returns all metadata inline; summary retains complete Evidence and returns build identity and counts for subsequent retained Go views.

tools.name: inspect_il2cpp_metadata
tools.title: Inspect Il2cpp Metadata
tools.description:
Inspect Unity IL2CPP metadata versions 24/27/29/31/39, optionally linking a selected 64-bit little-endian Mach-O/PE/ELF binary without execution. Returns metadata tables and derived native method links; shared addresses retain every method, zero slots mean no-body, and unknown ownership/relocations stay unknown. Default summary retains complete Evidence for inspect_analysis_view kind il2cpp-metadata using parent_evidence_id, named collections, original indices, fields and pages. Unrequested native counts are null; version27 names may be unknown. generic_instances adds supported static registration-table matches for versions 27/29/31. Executable-byte fallback is inferred and does not verify instruction boundaries. Full detail remains available; static agreement proves neither same-build pairing nor runtime behavior. Resource/unsupported-layout failures name their reasons.

When binary_architecture is provided, also provide binary_path.

detail.description: summary (default) retains complete Evidence and returns identity and collection counts; complete returns every image, type, method, member, parameter and string-literal row inline

tools.name: inspect_model_artifact
tools.title: Inspect Model Artifact
tools.description: Inspect GGUF v2/v3 or safetensors metadata and tensor declarations without loading weights or running inference. Default hash header commits only a prefix: full-file SHA-256 and Evidence subject remain unknown; hash full streams every byte for file identity. Tensor shapes/IDs/offsets are observed; textual types and totals are derived, with ambiguous layouts retaining unknown byte lengths. Metadata arrays are eight-element previews; scalar metadata is complete. Default summary retains complete Evidence; detail complete returns all declarations inline. Optional view selects metadata/tensors/types. To page retained tensors, use inspect_analysis_view with source:{kind:"retained-evidence",evidence_id:"<parent_evidence_id>"} and view:{kind:"model-artifact",collection:"tensors",offset:0,limit:32}. No payload inspection, quality claim, network, model runtime or pickle deserialization; one inspection at a time with explicit resource refusals.

tools.name: inspect_gpu_code_objects
tools.title: Inspect Gpu Code Objects
tools.description: Inspect CUDA/HIP code objects in local ELF/PE, fatbins, CUBIN, PTX or Clang HIP bundles without GPU tools or target execution. Default inventory hashes the full file; analysis kernels decodes selected object_ids/targets, with object_ids requiring the inventory expected_sha256. IDs are positional within that digest. Returns distinct PTX/CUBIN/AMDGPU kernel declarations, encoded/decoded provenance and explicit partial/unknown coverage; unsupported compression retains encoded locations. Default summary retains complete Evidence. Optional view selects targets/objects/kernels or PTX text; inspect_analysis_view kind gpu-code-objects pages retained facts without reopening (PTX offsets are UTF-16 units). No SASS disassembly, host-launch correlation or network; decoded-work/retention limits remain independent of selection.

tools.name: inspect_rust_binary
tools.title: Inspect Rust Binary
tools.description: Read the embedded cargo-auditable crate dependencies of a local ELF, PE, selected Mach-O slice or WebAssembly core module without running it or requiring Rust. Returns artifact identity, source ranges, ordered packages and dependency edges. Missing metadata does not prove no dependencies; a rustc commit from an observed source path is inferred. Default complete returns the report; detail summary retains it for inspect_analysis_view kind rust, collections packages/edges, or kind cyclonedx for one CycloneDX 1.6 document, via parent_evidence_id. Optional view selects a page in this call and cannot accompany explicit complete detail. Original row indices and every matching version survive selection; select dependencies explicitly for package dependency vectors. Runtime dependencies remain unknown; malformed or oversized inputs fail rather than return partial success.

tools.name: inspect_python_pyc
tools.title: Inspect Python Pyc
tools.description: Inspect local CPython 3.7–3.15 .pyc headers and nested code objects without executing bytecode, invoking Python or recovering source. Returns pinned version/header fields, names, constant summaries and bytecode lengths/digests; nested_code links code constants, not runtime calls. Default complete returns full Evidence; detail summary retains it for inspect_analysis_view kind python-pyc, collection code_objects, with exact names/indices/fields and paging. source_index preserves same-name alternatives. tools.name: inspect_nuget_nupkg

Returns package identity (id, version, authors, description), license and repository fields as present in the .nuspec, dependency groups with target frameworks and version ranges, and a ZIP contents inventory (entry names, sizes, encrypted flag, path-derived folder roles). tools.name: inspect_erlang_beam
tools.title: Inspect Erlang Beam
tools.description: Inspect an Erlang BEAM IFF file without executing bytecode or requiring Erlang. Returns chunk byte ranges/digests, atoms, exports/imports/lambdas and Code header. tools.name: inspect_v8_code_cache
tools.title: Inspect V8 Code Cache
tools.description: Inspect a local bytenode .jsc or compatible V8 code-cache container as static bytes, without V8, bytenode, child processes or decompilation. Returns artifact identity, header words with confirmed/inferred roles, producer family, recorded source length, payload identity and printable sequences with file ranges. Payload strings are byte patterns, not parsed heap objects; missing literals do not prove absence. The payload is not source: logic recovery needs a separate version-pinned decompiler. Resource refusals remain explicit.

tools.name: inspect_maven_gradle_metadata
tools.title: Inspect Maven Gradle Metadata
tools.description: Inspect a local Maven pom.xml or Gradle .module metadata file as static bytes, without running Maven or Gradle, resolving a dependency tree, or contacting a repository. Returns artifact identity, coordinates as spelled, parent and property declarations, dependency and dependencyManagement rows (scope, type, optional, classifier, exclusions, BOM import), Gradle variants and rich versions, and unresolved property or parent-coordinate references as explicit unknowns. Classification is from content, not the suffix. Malformed XML/JSON fails closed; unrecognized documents are unsupported. Resource refusals remain explicit.

tools.name: inspect_wasm_artifact
tools.title: Inspect Wasm Artifact
tools.description: Validate and inspect local WASM with caller-supplied WABT 1.0.42, without executing it or fetching dependencies. tools.name: inspect_apk_signature

tools.name: inspect_sqlite_database
tools.title: Inspect Sqlite Database
tools.description:

Supply a quiescent snapshot; no atomic live-snapshot claim. No arbitrary SQL, WHERE/ORDER BY, views/virtual tables, extensions, repair or encryption. Two inspections may run per provider; occupied capacity is retryable. Temporary-copy/worker bounds do not cap overall native heap.

When schema_scope is selected_table, also provide table. When row_limit is provided, also provide table. When columns is provided, also provide table. When row_offset is provided, also provide table.

tools.name: inspect_packet_fields
tools.title: Inspect Packet Fields
tools.description: Find protocols or field definitions registered in installed TShark 4.x. kind defaults to protocols; use fields with an optional exact protocol abbreviation, then pass selected names to inspect_packet_capture. query is a case-insensitive literal substring. tools.name: inspect_packet_capture
tools.title: Inspect Packet Capture
tools.description: Extract caller-selected TShark fields from a saved packet capture, with display filters, decode-as rules and pass mode preserved. Returns frame numbers, repeated values, coverage and diagnostics; use inspect_pcap_capture for a prepared endpoint/DNS/TLS/HTTP summary. Defaults to 50 matching frames; match_offset/match_limit page output and null requests all remaining. packet_limit counts input packets before filtering; output paging does not shorten dissection or reassembly. Requires Linux, prlimit and TShark 4.x on PATH or absolute REA_TSHARK_COMMAND. No live capture/device communication; no matches does not prove absence of traffic.

tools.name: inspect_signal_decoders
tools.title: Inspect Signal Decoders
tools.description: List installed sigrok decoder IDs/names, or supply an exact decoder ID to inspect its channel/option help. No recording, target, hardware scan or acquisition.

tools.name: decode_signal_recording
tools.title: Decode Signal Recording

Returns literal text, sample ranges, diagnostics, source/tool identity and coverage. line_offset/line_limit page display lines (default 50; null means all remaining), not annotations or samples; paging does not shorten decoding. Requires Linux, sigrok-cli 0.7.2 through absolute REA_SIGROK_COMMAND, and prlimit. No acquisition or device communication. Empty output does not prove absent traffic.

tools.name: inspect_managed_artifact
tools.title: Inspect Managed Artifact
tools.description: Inspect PE/CLI identity, classification and metadata inventories from an explicit path or selected managed target without loading or executing code. Default complete returns all producer facts; detail summary retains them and returns identity, assembly/MVID, frameworks, coverage and counts. Page references/resources/attributes with inspect_analysis_view kind managed and normalized_result.parent_evidence_id. Counts cover returned rows; partial, malformed and unavailable metadata stay explicit. Tokens are build-local. Use inspect_managed_members for methods, signatures and CIL anchors.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

tools.name: compare_managed_members
